llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: call the GitHub API using the token/username you provide. Before installing, verify the skill's source (package.json references a GitHub repo — inspect that repo and author), and follow least-privilege practices: create a PAT with only the scopes you actually need (use public_repo instead of repo if you only need public repos, or use GitHub's fine-grained tokens), consider a separate machine/service account for automation, and store the token in a secrets manager rather than a shared shell profile. Be aware the skill can create repos and issues using your token; if you want to avoid automated changes, either restrict the token's scopes or disable autonomous skill invocation in your agent settings. Rotate/revoke the token if you suspect misuse and monitor GitHub account activity after enabling the skill.
